headlines.title: Traders Game Plan What 10-Year Yield at 5% Spells for US Stocks
headlines.summary: The 10-year Treasury punching through 5% for the first time in nearly three years is the kind of tape event that reprices everything — equities, credit, real estate, you name it. With Morgan Stanley and Goldman both flipping to hike calls and the Fed meeting Wednesday, the long bond is running the show right now. Every rate-sensitive sector from utilities to tech growth is in the crosshairs, and the SPY can't catch a bid until this yield stabilizes.

headlines.title: Oil extends gains, Brent crude nears $108 following Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
headlines.summary: Brent kissing $108 with the Saudi East-West pipeline still dark is a genuine supply shock, not a headline — that pipeline is the workaround when Hormuz gets dicey, and right now both are compromised. Energy names catch a bid while the rest of the market gets squeezed by the inflation read-through, which is exactly the wrong cocktail heading into a Fed hike week. USO, XOM, and the refiners are the obvious tape movers; everything else is collateral damage.

headlines.title: Nvidia, chip stocks fall as AI CEOs call for slowdown
headlines.summary: When the people selling the shovels hear the gold rush might be pausing, you sell the shovels — Nasdaq-100 futures off more than 1.5% tells you the market took Amodei's essay seriously even if Trump called it a hoax. NVDA, AVGO, ASML, and the whole data center food chain got hit, and Citigroup's warning that earnings revisions could follow is the part that keeps portfolio managers up at night. This is a sentiment shock layered on top of an already wobbly tape; watch whether the dip gets bought or not.
